description: Changes a video series' end card, the short card every episode of the series ends on, as the series' page in Create does. make_new: its own card goes, and its next episode makes a new one in the series' look (episodes already made keep theirs). use_brand: its episodes end on the brand's end card instead. use_own: they end on the series' own card, made with the next episode when it has none. ask_ai: puts making it on the owner's own AI's homework list (homework for their AI must be on). The owner's own video is uploaded on the series' page; an AI on the owner's machine sends it with get_upload_link kind endcard and series. A card is made inside the next episode's run, within that episode's own budget, never as a charge of its own. Change it only when the owner asked for this change. It needs an act key.

action.description: make_new: its own card goes and the next episode makes a new one. use_brand: its episodes end on the brand's card. use_own: they end on its own (made with the next episode when it has none). ask_ai: the owner's own AI is asked to make it, on its homework list.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

series.description: The series' id or exact name. Leave out when the business has one video series.
